newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pharmaceutical shares rise on defensive buying.
newsitem.headline: Pharmaceutical shares rise on defensive buying.

text.p: Shares in pharmaceutical firms gained sharply on Wednesday on the Tokyo Stock Exchange with several issues, including Takeda Chemical Industries Co Ltd and Sankyo Co Ltd, climbing to their highest levels since the beginning of the year.
Shares in the sector were up 1.42 percent at 0158 GMT.

Participants were focusing on the drug firms' stable business performance as they were little affected by fluctuations in the dollar-yen rate and the planned hike in Japan's sales tax to from three to five percent in April, brokers said.
